title: goFlux / goAquaFlux
text: R package for chamber-based greenhouse-gas flux calculation. I develop its aquatic extension for floating chambers, including automatic bubble detection.

title: High-frequency GHG fluxes in aquatic ecosystems
text: Full-day GLEON workshop comparing manual and automated flux processing, with participants quantifying analyst subjectivity on shared data.

title: Google Earth Engine for limnologists
text: Four-activity beginner workshop: Sentinel-2 exploration, water masking, water-area time series and water-quality proxies.
